lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Can we talk about growth for a minute? Because I keep planning for a slow burn and I'm not sure that's right.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: I don't think it has to be slow. A photo product can move fast if the first screenshot is good enough.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The sharing loop does a lot of the work, that's true.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: It does all of the work, early on. Look at what happened with Instagram.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Go on.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Instagram launched in 2014, and inside about two years they were past a hundred million users. One tap, one image, something nice comes back. That's the same shape as ours.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: That's a pretty extreme comparison to hang our roadmap on.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Sure, but the mechanism is the mechanism. I'm not claiming we get their numbers.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I'll give you the mechanism. I won't give you the curve.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Fine. Then let's plan for the mechanism and be pleasantly surprised.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: What would we even share, though? A photo of my fridge is not aspirational.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: No, you'd share the result. Here's the three things I could make out of what looked like nothing.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Oh, that's better. The before and after framing.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Right, empty fridge, decent dinner. That's a format people repeat.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Okay, I like that more than I expected to. Put it on the list as a maybe.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Not for version one though. Version one is still photo in, three suggestions out.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: No, agreed, we're not building a feed. I just want to know the door exists.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The door exists. We'd need maybe two days to make a shareable card.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Two days is cheap. Alright, let's write it down and move on to onboarding.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Onboarding. My opinion is there shouldn't be any. Camera opens on first launch.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: No account, no tour, no permissions wall?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Camera permission, obviously. Beyond that, nothing. Take a photo, get a result.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: That I'm fully on board with. It's the fastest way to the thing that's actually good.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Good. Then let's leave it there for today.

moments.description: B builds a growth argument on Instagram as the comparison (line 3) and at line 5 states confidently that Instagram launched in 2014. It launched in October 2010, which also undercuts the two-year curve B is quoting.
